text:
maria: Opening an RFC PR to unify offline-signer delegation and the operator handshake for air-gapped installs. Need quick feedback on failure domains and the no-private-key promise for operators. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/427

sam: important constraint: operator must never persist any private keying material. even transient in-memory usage needs proof. can we design using short-lived unforgeable tokens instead of keys?

igor: agreed. proposal: operator validates rotation manifests signed by an offline signer. the offline signer issues a signed delegation token (JWT-like) that the operator forwards to node-side verifier-sidecar. the token contains exp, nonce, and signer_id.

lucy: how do we avoid halfway apply on partially-upgraded fleets? customers hit this during rolling upgrades. we need a clear canary stage and a global acceptance grace window.

maria: plan in RFC: three-phase rollout with explicit counters: PREPARE -> CANARY (N nodes) -> ROLL (global) -> FINALIZE. Each phase emits audit events and can be aborted within grace_window_seconds.

ana: for airgap specifically, provide USB-manifest path: admin generates rotation.tar.gz + rotation.sig, transfers via media, then runs operator CLI: `redwoodctl rotation apply --from-file rotation.tar.gz` which validates signature, checksum, and token.

igor: include manifest format example (RFC):
```text
rotation.tar.gz
|- rotation.json   # {signer_id, new_pub, grace_window_seconds, canary_count}
|- rotation.sig    # detached signature by offline-signing-key
|- attestation.txt # optional hw-attest chain
```

sam: what about stale signer cleanup? if new rotation fails, ensure old signer remains valid until explicit GC. operator should retain old signer metadata for `gc_retention_seconds` after finalize.

maria: yes. RFC adds retention and an admin `rotation rollback` verb. Also add `time-locked finalization` option; operator won't garbage collect until timestamp T.

lucy: compatibility: older operator (<v2.4) won't understand delegation tokens. we should ship a small compatibility shim where nodes accept both old static signer and delegation tokens for 30 days. document upgrade path.

igor: testing: add chaos tests simulating node crash during CANARY->ROLL, and media-corruption during USB transfer. verify operator rejects invalid checksums and logs detailed failure codes.

am: telemetry: emit rotation_prepare, rotation_canary_started, rotation_canary_failed, rotation_global_started, rotation_finalized, rotation_rollback. tie to traces so we can reconstruct timeline.

deploy-bot: rotation-manifest schema lint OK (3567890135) :white_check_mark:

sam: ops UX note: provide a dry-run mode that verifies signatures and computes canary set without changing state. CLI `redwoodctl rotation apply --dry-run`

maria: good. I'll update PR with CLI examples, the USB admin runbook, retention/gc knobs, and the compat shim proposal. tagging @igor @lucy for review. Thanks! :thumbsup:
